$comment: Pulse /classify classify_config. Forced-choice with no confidence, so the catch-all class carries no pipeline_id and is the refusal path.

w1_permit.description: Texas Railroad Commission Form W-1, Application for Permit to Drill, Recomplete, or Re-Enter: a numbered-item form with operator, lease, well number, purpose-of-filing checkboxes, surface location items 11-25, and a field information table.

plat.description: A surveyor's plat or map drawing showing a well location within a survey or section: scale bar, north arrow, distance calls to lease and survey lines, surveyor seal or certification.

completion_report.description: RRC Form W-2 or G-1 completion report: casing, cementing, perforation, and test data for a completed well.

well_log.description: A wireline log image: depth track with curves such as gamma ray, resistivity, or density, with a header block.

correspondence.description: Letters, problem letters, notices, or emails about a permit or well.

unrecognized.description: Any page or document that does not clearly match the classes above, including blank pages, illegible scans, and cover sheets.
